normal.name: Normal
normal.summary: Adaptable generalist. Normal moves are never resisted.

fire.name: Fire
fire.summary: Burst striker. Fire moves Burn: damage each turn.

water.name: Water
water.summary: Displacement and sustain. Water moves push the target 1 further.

grass.name: Grass
grass.summary: Drain and control. Grass moves heal the user for 25% of the damage dealt.

electric.name: Electric
electric.summary: Fast skirmisher. Electric moves Paralyze: the target cannot move on its next turn.

ice.name: Ice
ice.summary: Lockdown control. Ice moves Freeze: the target cannot act on its next turn.

fighting.name: Fighting
fighting.summary: Melee bruiser. +25% damage when an ally also stands next to the target.

poison.name: Poison
poison.summary: Attrition. Poison stacks: every new application adds its turns.

ground.name: Ground
ground.summary: Terrain shaper. Ground moves turn the ground under the target into mud.

flying.name: Flying
flying.summary: Mobility. Flies over water, mud and other Pokémon.

psychic.name: Psychic
psychic.summary: Ranged manipulation. Psychic moves pull the target 1 closer.

bug.name: Bug
bug.summary: Swarm tactics. +10% damage for each ally next to the target.

rock.name: Rock
rock.summary: Fortress. Cannot be pushed or pulled.

ghost.name: Ghost
ghost.summary: Trickster. Moves through enemies; Ghost moves Curse: +25% damage taken.

dragon.name: Dragon
dragon.summary: Rare all-rounder. Dragon moves ignore Defense.

dark.name: Dark
dark.summary: Opportunist. Dark moves deal +30% to foes below half HP or carrying a status.

steel.name: Steel
steel.summary: Bulwark. Steel Pokémon take 15% less damage from every hit.

fairy.name: Fairy
fairy.summary: Charmer. Fairy moves Soften: the target deals 15% less damage on its next turn.
